title: Biggest Update Yet!
description: Adds content based on the iconic "Juan" meme!
body:
# ![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/adf9c67dd0bea26da2de1080b96ed2d990835791.png)
 
[![Modrinth Link](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/modrinth_vector.svg&;n=-1)](https://modrinth.com/project/biggest-update-yet) [![CurseForge Link](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/available/curseforge_vector.svg&;n=-1)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/biggest-update-yet)


### Based on: (With creative liberties.)
![JuanMeme](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3033876726fa832b688ee5ef8aba9e70dff5527.jpeg)
I thought this meme would be super funny to bring to the game. Especially adding it to a friends modpack secretly would be hilarious. I hope everybody has fun with this mod.

### Take a look at the Juans:
![ManyJuans](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4624bd675228e6929edd578d8267995220550de5.png)
Juan spawns in the Maple Forest biome, they function like a cow. They can be milked, and killed for Raw Juan, which can be turned into Cooked Juan via furnace, smoker and campfire.

### Take a look at the Maple Forest Biome:
# ![MapleForest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1d140b33c9c42e9b6abfd4768cec23d11172ca3.png)
Can be found near other forest-like biomes. Generates with pumpkins and berry bushes to keep an "autumn-like" theme. 

### Lavender Flowers:
![LavenderFlowers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/894ce81b9c0c718ef5b2dd0497e6293ebfd139c7.png)
Lavender flowers can be turned into purple dye via crafting.

### New Blocks/Woodset:
![NewBlocks/Wood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d2a347d361365e2977de16cca060a17b8a8b492.png)
A yellowy brown woodset to match real life Maple Wood.

Thank you all for checking my mod out!
